HammondCare provides expert aged care, home care, dementia care and palliative care for older people, regardless of circumstances, beliefs, background or financial situation. We are led by our not-for-profit, Christian foundations and backed by research and clinical expertise.

It's not just care. It's HammondCare. 

About the role 

The role of Finance Officer ensures that billing, Residential payment statements, receipting, electronic claiming, reconciliations, month end reports are carried out in a timely and accurate manner and in accordance with relevant legislation. The Finance officer will also be providing operational support and assisting finance team members with queries relating to billing, debtor collection, and account enquires.

This role is a permanent full-time position based at St Leonards. Working from Home (WFH) arrangements are available to team members, subject to meeting the requirements of the role and operational needs.

NFP salary packaging ($15,900 tax free) plus meals and entertainment benefit (up to $2,650 tax free)

Additional leave purchase options and 14 weeks paid parental leave

Flexible working options, including hybrid arrangements

Discounts on everyday products and services

Discounted healthcare memberships - access to network of fitness centres and pools for employees and families

Free access to independent counselling support for employees and families

Health & Wellbeing programmes

Reward & Recognition programmes

Referral bonuses

Career and professional development opportunities

Key Responsibilities include

Processing of Admissions and Discharges in line with Aged Care Standards

Invoicing-Claiming-Reconciliations with external providers e.g. Services Australia, Private Health Insurance providers, Local Health Districts and suppliers to HammondCare in line with legislation, including New Aged Care Act.

Oversight of unspent funds, client transfers and funding upgrades-changes

Process reimbursements and discharges in accordance with relevant legislative timeframes and guidelines

Assisting with Credit control-Debtor collection

Receipting of payments and reconciliations including preparing journal entries for banking to be posted to Coupa

Client Account enquiries

Liaising with different stakeholders in operations, finance and other HammondCare teams

Data Analysis with some data entry to identify trends and matters to be investigated further.

Identify efficiency opportunities and best practise, to raise with their manager.

Ad hoc projects as required: Including increase in adoption of work orders across the business and enhancements to exception reporting. 

About You 

Commitment to engage and align with HammondCare's Christian Mission, Motivation and Mission in Action

Experience in similar finance roles including billing, revenue, payable

Engaged in or completed accounting related studies such as a Certificate in Accounting, Diploma in Accounting (Finance) or similar studies

Cert IV in relevant field or undergraduate degree

Excellent communication, verbal and written

Negotiation skills, with a customer focused approach

Ability to handle sensitive conversations with empathy , patience and professionalism

Immediate to advanced computer skills, specifically MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)

Ability to work independently and as part of a team

To Apply 

If you are ready to make a difference with HammondCare, Apply Now! 

Pre- Employment Checks 

All short-listed applicants for these positions will be asked to consent to a criminal record check and references.

HammondCare is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and inclusion. We strive on creating an equal employment environment where everyone from any background can be themselves.

result.description:
On behalf of our client, we’re looking for a full-time experienced Painter. 

This role will be required to perform various façade building repairs and installations to the façade of high rise building both Commercial and Residential. This will include preparing of various surfaces, including removal of redundant paint, identifying any failures in the surfaces and repaid of these surfaces, selection and application of pain coatings, removal and repaid of window frames and adjacent areas. 

The daily duties and responsibilities include: 
• Preparing surfaces and work areas for painting
• Selecting and preparing paint for application 
• Apply pain using a variety of tools
• Cleaning tools and work areas
• Quote new business façade remediation services
• Form key relationship with suppliers, building managers, subcontractors, clients and engineers
• Coordinating with engineers in relation to work methods and approvals of work complete
• Ensure all staff including yourself acknowledge and adhere to Heigh Safety regulations
• Scheduling regular maintenance for tools and equipment

Education – Possession of relevant Certificate III qualification, and/or relevant employment experience 

Experience & Skills 
• Holding a current IRATA licence is essential to this role – applicants who do not have this will not be considered
• Management and Scheduling of staff skills
• Ability to prioritise and control workload arising from a broader user base
• Ability to work constructively and collaboratively in a team environment
• Ability to work in a multi-cultural and multi-national environment
 
Salary: Salary being offered is commensurate with qualifications and experience, with a range between $79,499 – $95,000.
